_about: Fixed answers for checking the coach against config/rubric.ts. Each case is one answer to one objection, scored the way a retry is (generateRetryFeedback). Ranges are our expectation from the anchors, written before running the coach; widen one only with a reason. Order of each range list: clear_request, evidence, structure, objection_handling, next_step.

cases.answer: Yeah, I mean, I totally understand. Maybe we can talk about it some other time.
I've been working really hard this year and I think I deserve more money. I was hoping we could maybe look at my pay.
I understand budgets are tight. I'm asking for a 10% raise because I automated our reporting and trained the new hires. Can we talk about it again soon?

I know the budget is frozen until next quarter, so I'm not asking for money today. I'm asking for a 10% raise, to $99,000, starting in the new budget. I cut weekly reporting from five hours to three, and I trained two new colleagues on billing in March. Can we agree it goes into the Q1 budget, and confirm at our 1:1 on January 15th?
I'm asking for a 10% raise. This year I cut weekly reporting from five hours to three, which saves the team about eighty hours a year, and I trained two new colleagues on billing in March.
Could we sit down on Friday the 12th and decide on my compensation? I'd like you to tell me then what you'd need to see.
Honestly, that's what you said last year. If there's no money for me, maybe I should look elsewhere.

I understand the freeze, and I don't want to put you in a bad spot. Since automating the export cut my reporting from five hours to three, could we agree on the raise for when the budget reopens next quarter?
Okay, I guess I can try to fit it in somehow.

I want the audit done well too. I'm leading the payments migration, due Friday, and the Q3 incident report, due next Wednesday. If I take the audit now, one of those slips. Can we move the audit to next sprint, or tell me today which one should give?
I'm pretty swamped with the migration right now, so I don't think I can take on the audit.
I understand the team is stretched. I'm on the payments migration until Friday, so could the audit move to next sprint? We could revisit priorities next week.
You're always late with stuff and it's becoming a problem for everyone.

I hear you've been swamped, and I should have flagged the deadline more clearly. Last week your section came in two days late, and I rewrote the summary overnight on Tuesday. Going forward, I need your part by Thursday noon. Can we agree on that and check in Friday morning?
I get that you're busy, but the report was late and it caused problems. Can you try to be on time?
Can we set up a time on Thursday to talk about the report deadlines?
I mean, it's fine, I guess. It's just been kind of a lot lately.

I know you've done a lot for me, and I love helping you. But I'm not lending the car on weekends anymore. Last month it came back empty twice, and I missed my Saturday shift. I can drive you to the station this Saturday at 8. Would that work?
I'm sorry, I just can't keep lending you the car. It's been causing problems for me.
I love you, but no more weekend car loans. I can lend it on weekdays when I work from home.
